title: TSS ScenarioPattern Schema
description: A reusable, recurring or high-value situational pattern. First-class object defined normatively by TSS v1.2.0 §5.10 and §8 (previously carried only as the context-level `patterns: []` array with no dedicated schema). v1.0: initial schema covering TSS-SCEN-01..04.

label.description: Human-readable name (TSS-SCEN-01), e.g. 'Wildfire', 'Caregiving week', 'Transition or handoff'.

context_id.description: The Context this ScenarioPattern is assigned to (TSS-SCEN-04). A pattern MUST be assignable to a Context; it MAY be authored context-agnostically and assigned at use.

triggers.description: The triggers or applicable conditions under which this pattern applies (TSS-SCEN-02, §8.2).

defaults.description: Default priorities and/or risks this pattern asserts when active (TSS-SCEN-03). At least one of `priorities` or `risks` SHOULD be present.

priorities.description: Default priorities to elevate while this pattern is active.

risks.description: Default risks to surface while this pattern is active.

involved_entities.description: Optional. Entity ids most likely to be involved (§8.2).

involved_roles.description: Optional. Role ids most likely to be involved (§8.2).

departures.description: Optional. Recorded departures from the pattern when they occur (§8.2).
